_comment: Coverage ratchet for the blocking `line coverage` CI job (.github/workflows/ci.yml). The job fails when total line coverage drops below `line_pct - tolerance_pct`. Raise `line_pct` when coverage genuinely improves — the job prints a ::notice:: when it does. Lowering it requires a stated reason in the PR description. Same discipline as parity/baseline.json. `line_pct` must come from a real run of that job, never a local `cargo llvm-cov`: for this same commit CI measured 83.54% of 126086 lines while macOS measured 82.79% of 125721. The denominators differ because the two platforms compile different cfg'd code, so the two numbers are not comparable and a local one would set the floor wrong.
